board.name: EV721FL0_R03_ST7789
board.description: EV721FL0_R03 开发板 + 外接 ST7789 240×240 SPI LCD（PB7/8/9/10/PA25/PA26）+ 4 按键（PA29/PA30/PA31/PB0）

devices.name: ST7789 SPI LCD 240×240
devices.notes: ST7789 240×240 SPI LCD。SPI1(spi_idx=1): SCLK=PB_7 MOSI=PB_8 CS=PB_10(GPIO手动)，DC=PB_9，RST=PA_25，BLK=PA_26(背光)。用法：local d=require('display'); d.init('display_spi_st7789')
devices.usage_guide: Init: local d=require('display'); local ok,err=d.init('display_spi_st7789'). Read rolfs:/docs/display.md for the full 2D drawing API.
